Knowledge that comes from the place

Erg Chigaga is not just any stop.

Abdoul was born in the Sahara. Today, besides running his own fleet of 4×4s, he owns a camp in Erg Chigaga. That direct relationship with the place shapes a large part of the experiences we design.
